# Aerini

> Aerini is a local-first visual workflow engine: wire nodes together on a canvas, then run the same engine on your machine or a headless server.

No account, no cloud, no telemetry. Aerini's interface loads one font from Google Fonts; the only other call is the Check for Updates button, when clicked.

Desktop app for Windows (x64), macOS (Apple Silicon only), and Linux (x64 and ARM64). Current release line: 0.4 (pre-1.0). 40 built-in nodes in seven categories: Triggers, Core Actions, Files & Storage, Integrations, AI, Logic, and Utility. Workflows run manually, on a schedule, or from a webhook.

The workflow engine is a standalone Rust crate (`aerini-engine`) that can be embedded in other programs. A separate headless binary (`aerini-server`) runs workflows unattended, without the desktop app. Third-party plugin nodes compile to WebAssembly and run in a sandboxed Wasmtime instance with capped memory, a per-call time limit, filtered outbound HTTP, and no filesystem access; the Plugins panel installs single `.wasm` nodes or multi-node `.aerinipkg` packs via file picker or drag-and-drop. AI Prompt and AI Agent can point at Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server on your own hardware instead of a hosted API. A workflow behind a Webhook trigger can also be exposed as an embeddable chat widget, dropped onto any web page with one script tag; it is served by aerini-server in api mode.

Licensed AGPL-3.0: free to use, study, and modify. Distributing a modified version — including running it as a network service for others — requires sharing those changes back. A commercial license removes that requirement.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://aerini.org/): Product overview, how it works, feature list, and download links for every platform.
- [FAQ](https://aerini.org/#faq): Answers on license, cost, platform support, and how to contribute.
- [Pricing](https://aerini.org/pricing): The commercial license — a flat one-time fee for teams shipping a modified version without the AGPL's share-back requirement.
- [Commercial license terms](https://aerini.org/license-terms): The full text of the Aerini Commercial License Agreement. A permanent copy of each version is kept at a versioned URL (e.g. /license-terms-v1.0).
- [Contact](https://aerini.org/contact): Email, GitHub Issues, and GitHub Discussions contact channels.
- [Privacy policy](https://aerini.org/privacy): What the website stores (nothing) vs. shares with third parties (your IP, via fonts and checkout), and what the app sends over the network (nothing on its own).
- [Security policy](https://aerini.org/security): How to report a vulnerability, response timeline, and what's protected by default.

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Panchak2d/Aerini): Source code, releases, and discussions.
- [AGPL-3.0 license](https://github.com/Panchak2d/Aerini/blob/main/LICENSE): Full license text, in the same repository.
